braid_group.module::charge: Admit requested<=limit, including equality and zero; otherwise return Budget preserving what, requested and limit without saturation or truncation.
braid_group.module::product: Checked u128 product with empty product one; report Overflow at the first overflowing multiplication, never wrap.
braid_group.module::braid_relation_defects: Delegate the entire ordered defect enumeration to the declared default limits.
braid_group.module::braid_relation_defects_with_limi: Determine n from the first generator (zero for empty input), validate all shapes before cost admission, admit aggregate storage/work, then list all singular defects followed by adjacent/far defects in original i-major order. Empty input returns no defects; 0x0 generators are singular.
braid_group.module::check_generator_shapes: Find the first generator not shaped (n,n) and return Shape with expected shape and the actual bad shape. Empty input passes; this private helper does not assert n>0.
braid_group.module::relation_admission: Checked aggregate generator storage g*n^2 before work estimation. Charge 2*(g*(g-1)+4*max(g-1,0))*n^3+3*g*n^3+g*n*(n+1), with the g-1 factors explicitly zero-clamped as combinatorial empty-pair counts. This conservative scalar-operation model may refuse before rank/multiplication. Shaped native inputs and the first admitted storage bound prove the remaining small u128 factors safe.
braid_group.module::singular_defects: Append Singular{i} in input order when n=0 or the exact pinned elimination rank is below n; propagate provider failures and preserve prior defect vector ordering.
braid_group.module::pair_defects: Private i<generators.len() and common admitted square shape: append the adjacent braid failure at i, then far failures (i,j) in ascending j>=i+2. Never reorder multiplication or swap defect witnesses.
braid_group.module::braid_triple: Under admitted compatible shapes, compute (a*b)*a with checked exact provider multiplication and the same per-operation limits.
braid_group.module::projective_normal_form: Borrow any shaped matrix. Return None exactly for the all-zero matrix; otherwise take the first row-major nonzero entry lambda and return (lambda^-1*m,lambda). Delegate inverse/scale failures. Reconstruction is m=lambda*normal; this function allocates its necessary owned returned matrix.
braid_group.module::equal_up_to_scalar: Return None for shape mismatch, either zero matrix, or unequal canonical normal forms. Otherwise return lb/la, the oriented factor satisfying b=(lb/la)*a; inversion/division failures remain typed.
braid_group.FiniteMatrixGroup::order: Read the immutable number of distinct retained elements/classes.
braid_group.FiniteMatrixGroup::elements: Borrow the immutable discovery-order elements. No public mutable field or view can invalidate shape/index/closure invariants.
braid_group.FiniteMatrixGroup::is_projective: Read whether stored representatives are canonical projective classes.
braid_group.FiniteMatrixGroup::contains: Refuse mismatching shape as false before scalar work. In ordinary mode query the borrowed row-major slice directly, with no matrix clone/allocation. In projective mode canonicalize nonzero input and query its class; zero returns false and provider errors propagate.
braid_group.ClosureOutcome::order: Return Some(number of elements) only for Finite; ExceedsBound returns None and never asserts infinitude.
braid_group.module::group_closure: Delegate bounded ordinary/projective forward closure to default operation limits, without preallocating by the requested bound.
braid_group.module::group_closure_with_limits: Admit nonempty common positive square shape, generator storage/work and invertibility before the zero-bound outcome. For bound>0 seed canonical identity and explore right-products in BFS discovery order. A new candidate at full bound yields ExceedsBound; a completed frontier yields Finite. Budget/provider failure discards partial state rather than exposing a finite certificate.
braid_group.module::closure_dimension: Reject missing generators with ListLength; reject zero/non-square first shape with NotSquare; reject first incompatible sibling with Shape carrying its actual shape; return common positive dimension.
braid_group.module::closure_admission: Admit g*n^2 generator slots and g*n*(2*n^2+n+1) conservative rank work before exact rank tests. Reject the first singular generator before any bound=0 result; no group storage is allocated here.
braid_group.module::normalized: Own a product matrix. Ordinary mode moves it unchanged. Projective mode refuses an unexpected all-zero product, computes one inverse of its first nonzero entry, and scales each original coordinate in place using safe matrix set. A nonzero coordinate implies cols>0; row-major loop indices stay in shape. No second dense buffer or matrix clone is allocated; errors drop the owned partial matrix.
braid_group.module::initial_group: Private admitted n>0: charge four*n^2 logical scalar slots (two retained arrays and a conservative two-buffer scratch allowance), allocate identity once, clone only the required hash key, and move identity into elements. Identity is already projectively canonical and is not normalized again.
braid_group.module::record_element: Private admitted compatible canonical h: return true if key already exists; if new and elements.len()>=bound return false before inserting. Otherwise clone exactly one key into the hash set and move h into the ordered vector. The caller has already charged retained/scratch slots.
braid_group.module::expand_closure: Private current<elements.len(), matching admitted generators, immutable scalar hashes: for each generator charge 2*(states+1)*n^2 retained-plus-scratch slots, then checked-add 2*n^3 plus projective (n^2+1) scalar work. Multiply the borrowed current element on the right, normalize its owned result in place and record a new element/class; stop on first excess-bound candidate or typed failure.

yang_baxter.module::charge: Admit requested<=limit exactly; otherwise return the original typed Budget fields.
yang_baxter.module::preflight: Private calls use four dense products and storage coefficients 5,9 or 10. Checked-compute d=n^3 and entries=d^2 in usize, charge storage*entries before matrix construction, then charge 8*d^3+(storage+1)*entries scalar work. These small fixed coefficients and d^2<=usize::MAX keep the widened u128 arithmetic safe on the recorded 64-bit target. Cost units exclude bit sizes and arbitrary callback work.
yang_baxter.module::base_dimension: Require a positive square matrix with row count exactly n^2. Use widened u128 lower-bound binary search, rejecting zero or a non-square row count with the exact shape. On 64-bit usize every midpoint<2^64, so mid^2 fits u128; conversion of the admitted positive root is checked.
yang_baxter.module::swap_matrix: Delegate the exact flip on K^n tensor K^n to default element/operation limits.
yang_baxter.module::swap_matrix_with_limits: Checked-compute the two-particle dimension n^2, then allocate exactly one bounded dense matrix with entry delta(i,l)*delta(j,k). Zero n yields a 0x0 matrix without callback evaluation; guard divisions by n.max(1).
yang_baxter.module::check_family_shape: Private n is obtained from an admitted first carrier, hence n^2 fits usize. Validate this matrix as a positive square-square carrier, then require exactly the same base dimension; mismatch returns Shape with expected (n^2,n^2) and actual shape.
yang_baxter.module::tensor_embedding: Validate common carrier and checked three-particle dimension, then allocate one bounded dense embedding only for the requested First=(12), Outer=(13), or Last=(23) pair. Decode row/column into ordered triples, retain the spectator Kronecker delta, and clone precisely the selected two-particle coefficient. Every coefficient index is below n^4. No identity/flip matrix, scalar multiplication by delta, unused embedding or conjugating dense product is constructed.
yang_baxter.module::triple_product: Compute (m0*m1)*m2 with two checked exact multiplications and the same limits, preserving argument order.
yang_baxter.module::triple_difference: Return left0*left1*left2 minus right0*right1*right2, with checked products and exact subtraction. This computes a defect and does not pre-assert it is zero.
yang_baxter.module::remaining_family: Evaluate b then c exactly once each before shape checks, propagate each callback error unchanged, then validate rb before rc against n. Return owned matrices by move, without extra copies.
yang_baxter.module::spectral_values: Call family(a) once, validate its base carrier and preflight four products with the selected storage coefficient before invoking b/c. Then obtain the other two values in the declared order. Callback allocation/work/panics are caller-domain responsibilities outside this library cost model.
yang_baxter.module::alternate_triple: Construct only the three requested alternating slot embeddings and compute their ordered triple product; drop these local embeddings before the caller constructs the opposite side.
yang_baxter.module::braid_form_defect: Delegate the constant braid defect to default limits.
yang_baxter.module::braid_form_defect_with_limits: Admit carrier and the (four-products,five-slot) model; construct only r12 and r23 and return r12*r23*r12-r23*r12*r23. No r13 is constructed.
yang_baxter.module::spectral_form_defect: Delegate the three-argument spectral defect to default limits; parameters are passed as supplied, not reinterpreted as differences or ratios.
yang_baxter.module::spectral_form_defect_with_limits: Evaluate family once per argument with common carrier and (four-products,nine-slot) admission; construct only ra12, rb13 and rc23 and return ra12*rb13*rc23-rc23*rb13*ra12.
yang_baxter.module::spectral_braid_form_defect: Delegate the alternating three-argument braid defect to default limits.
yang_baxter.module::spectral_braid_form_defect_with_: Evaluate x,y,z once with common carrier and (four-products,ten-slot) admission; return rx12*ry23*rz12-rz23*ry12*rx23. Drop left-side embeddings before building the right side; parameter order remains observable.
yang_baxter.module::yang_rational: Checked-compute dimension n^2, allocate one bounded matrix, and fill the exact entry of u*I+P: u+1 on diagonal flip overlap, u on diagonal-only, one on flip-only, zero otherwise. Zero n returns empty matrix without division callback; no temporary identity, scaled matrix, flip matrix or addition buffer is allocated.
yang_baxter.module::hecke: Compute inverse(q), refusing zero/provider contract failure, then return the exact fixed 4x4 Hecke braid matrix with middle off-diagonals one and entry (2,2)=q-q^-1. The matrix is supplied data, not a newly admitted braid-group representation.
yang_baxter.module::hecke_quadratic_defect: Admit positive square matrix and fixed storage/work model before inverse(q); return (r-q*I)*(r+q^-1*I) with checked matrix operations. Nonzero output is a valid defect, not an exception.
yang_baxter.module::hecke_admission: Reject non-square/empty carrier, then charge 4*n^2 storage followed by 2*n^3+4*n^2 scalar work under default limits. The first bound proves the subsequent widened cubic arithmetic safe.
yang_baxter.module::six_vertex: Compute a=q*z-(q*z)^-1, b=z-z^-1 and c=q-q^-1 with exact typed inverses in that order; return the fixed symmetric 4x4 six-vertex matrix with diagonal a,b,b,a and middle off-diagonals c. Zero/inverse-contract failures propagate; no spectral parameter relation is imposed here.
